args.code: (function() { try { var btns = document.querySelectorAll('button'); var target = null; for (var i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) { if (btns[i].textContent.indexOf('选择') >= 0) { target = btns[i]; break; } } if (target) { target.click(); return {clicked: true, text: target.textContent}; } return {buttons: Array.prototype.slice.call(btns,0,5).map(function(b){return b.textContent;})}; } catch(e) { return {error: e.message}; } })()
